notes.title: Playtest Is Over... for now
notes.notes:
[p]First of all, thanks everyone!! It was a blast to be able to see your playthrough videos.

Silksong is around the corner, and we think is better to pause the playtest for now since you are going to be focused on it for sure hehe ːsteamhappyːWe received really valuable feedback and we are already working on improving the game, polishing some details and even adding new content!

Stay tuned for updates about the changes in the upcoming weeks.

A new playtest will be available in October, see you there!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157645/2457aff150d79250fbaf42a1e3073380c7620d7f.jpg"][/img] [/p][p]- Amilcar and Alejandro[/p]

notes.title: Xplorite Playtest is Live
notes.notes:
[p]Xplorite Playtest is Live!  [/p][p]You can apply for it on the Xplorite Store Page [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2720230/Xplorite/"][/dynamiclink]We are going to let a few people join each day, please be patient if you don't get access right away. 

This playtest only covers a few areas of the game, you may encounter some invisible walls blocking your path, but you can play it as many times as you want, and even create multiple save profiles for that.
It would be awesome if you can give us feedback at the end of the playtest session, for that you can find a [b]Share Feedback [/b]button on the Menu or in the Pause screen while playing the game.

Let us know your thoughts!

Thanks!
Amilcar and Alejandro[/p]

notes.title: Playtest Incoming
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone! First announcement here! And its a nice one.

We are going to open the gates to our game with a playtest.

It will be available for at least a month, so make sure you apply for it if you want a sneak peak of the game.
[/p][p]Your feedback will help us improve the last details of the game, so please use the in-game [b]Give Feedback [/b]button to do so.[/p]
